defiQ1E: At 0°, the point is at (1, 0): its x-coordinate, so cos 0°, is 1.
defiQ2E: At 90°, the point is at the top of the circle, at (0, 1): sin 90° = 1.
defiQ3E: A half turn is π radians: π rad = 180°.
defiQ4E: sin 30° = 1/2: one of the special values worth remembering.
defiQ5: On the unit circle, cos θ is…
defiQ5E: cos θ is read on the horizontal axis: it is the x-coordinate of point M.

calibrageAide: A few questions to adapt your notebook: answer without looking it up, "I don't know" is a fine answer. This is not a grade.
calibrageSansQuestion: No question for these topics: your notebook starts right away.
calibrageResultat: Notebook adapted: {n} topic(s) you already know move to the end, as extra practice.
calibrageTout: Notebook adapted: we go through each topic from the start.
classesIntro: Your classes and invitation links: share a link so your students can join you.
elevesIntro: Follow your students: this week's activity and the topics of your subjects to review.
profProfilAide: What your students see when they join you, and what sets up your classes.
profNomAide: For example “Mr Martin” or “Ms Diallo”. No address or phone number.
profProfilManquant: Set up your teacher profile first (subjects and levels) to create classes.
profSupprimerClasseAide: Students of this class will no longer be followed and its links will be disabled.
profParticuliersResume: {n} student(s) followed in private lessons. A private lesson link works only once.
profLienAideClasse: Share with class {classe}: each student opens it from their account. Valid until {date}.
profLienAideParticulier: Give it to one student only, for private lessons. Valid until {date}, once.
profLienUneFois: The link is shown only once: Kermiclab keeps only its fingerprint. You can create another one.
profAucunEleve: No student here yet: share an invitation link from “My classes”.
profAlerte_jamais: {pseudo} has not shared any activity yet.
profRetirerAide: The student will no longer be followed; their account and progress are not affected.
profConnexionRequise: Sign in to your account (linked online) in “My account” to open the teacher area.
profRoleRequis: The teacher area is reserved for the Teacher role, granted by the Kermiclab team.
profErreur_nom-court: The display name needs at least {min} characters.
profErreur_nom-long: The display name must not exceed {max} characters.
profErreur_nom-caracteres: The display name may only contain letters, digits, spaces and . ' -
profErreur_nom-chiffres: No phone number in the display name.
profErreur_profil-requis: Set up your teacher profile first.
profErreur_classe-long: The class name must not exceed {max} characters.
profErreur_classe-caracteres: The class name may only contain letters, digits, spaces and . ' -
profErreur_classe-chiffres: No phone number in the class name.
profErreur_matiere-hors-profil: This subject is not in your profile.
profErreur_niveau-hors-profil: This level is not in your profile.
profErreur_quota-invitations: Too many active links: disable one.
profErreur_code-invalide: This link or code is not valid (unknown, expired or already used).
profErreur_propre-invitation: This is your own invitation link: give it to your students.
profErreur_accord-requis: Tick the agreement to share your progress.
profErreur_quota-professeurs: You already follow {max} teachers: leave one before joining another.
profErreur_introuvable: Item not found: refresh the page.
mesProfsVide: You don't follow any teacher. Your teacher can give you a link or a code.
mesProfsAttente: You opened a teacher's invitation link: sign in (account linked online) to join.
mesProfsQuitte: You no longer share your progress with this teacher.
rejoindreDeja: You already follow them: this link only changes your class.
rejoindrePartage: Your teacher will see your nickname, this week's activity (XP, minutes) and your mastery of the topics of their subject. Never your questions, badges or workbooks. You can stop at any time.
rejoindrePseudoAide: Your first name or nickname, as you want to be recognised in class.
rejoindreAccordTitre: I agree to share my progress with this teacher.
rejoindreAccordTexte: I can leave at any time from “My account”.
contribSuiviAide: Follow each suggestion from submission to publication in the topic: review by a teacher, approval, then integration through a pull request.
contribSuiviAlerte: {n} suggestion(s) waiting for your fix: read the reviewer's comment, then fix and resubmit.
suiviIntro: Your students' engagement and performance, assigned activities and students to follow.
suiviAucuneActivite: No activity yet: “Assign an activity” offers four kinds.
actAucuneCible: Create a class or invite a student first.
actAide_defi: 5 questions drawn from the published quizzes of the chosen topics; the student can replay, the best score is kept.
actAide_evaluation: {min} to {max} questions drawn from the published quizzes of the chosen topics; one attempt, the score is kept.
actAide_cahier: A workbook built from the catalogue, or written by AI; each student's progress comes back here.
actAide_objectif: A goal measured automatically from the student's progress, without asking them anything.
actCahierIaAide: {n} of {m} AI workbooks left today. Without AI, the workbook is built from the catalogue.
actCahierIaIndisponible: AI unavailable: the workbook will be built from the catalogue.
actNotionsAide: 1 to {max} topics from your subjects; the class level first.
actDonneeMoinsQuestions: Activity assigned: the catalogue only has {n} questions for these topics.
actErreur_cible-invalide: Choose a class or a student.
actErreur_notion-hors-profil: A topic is not in your subjects.
actErreur_echeance-invalide: The date must be within the next 6 months.
actErreur_profil-requis: Set up your teacher profile first.
actErreur_libelle-long: Title too long (60 characters at most).
actErreur_libelle-caracteres: The title may only contain letters, digits, spaces and . ' -
actErreur_libelle-chiffres: No phone number in the title.
actErreur_sans-questions: The catalogue has no quiz for these topics yet: choose others.
profErreur_quota-activites: Too many ongoing activities: archive the finished ones.
quizAideDefi: Challenge from {prof}: {n} questions. You can replay; your best score is kept.
quizAideEvaluation: Assessment from {prof}: {n} questions, one attempt. Only your score is sent, never your answers.
quizManquantes: {n} unanswered question(s): check again to finish anyway.
quizSansQuestion: No published question for these topics yet.
efAucuneActivite: No activity yet: "Give an activity" offers challenges, assessments, goals and notebooks, for one child or the whole family.
actEleveTitreTous: Work from your family and your teachers
efErreur_aucun-enfant: Add a child to your family first.
efErreur_quota-activites: You already have 60 activities in progress: archive some before giving more.
efViewAsAide: Select the children whose progress you want to view. All children are selected by default.
efSelectionVide: Select at least one child to view their progress.
efProfesseursVide: No teacher assignments for the selected children.
synchroVerrouilleeCle: On, locked: enter your password to sync.
synchroActiveeCle: Sync is on: this device's data is online. Keep your recovery kit below.
synchroRetrouverTitre: I already turned on sync on another device
synchroRetrouverAide: On your other device, choose “Add a device” and enter the code shown there. You can also enter the key from your recovery kit, or your secret phrase if you still use the old method.
synchroSecretLabel: Pairing code, recovery key or secret phrase
synchroSecretAide: The code has 16 characters, the recovery key 56; dashes and spaces are optional.
synchroCleFaute: This recovery key contains a typo: check it character by character.
synchroCleFormat: This recovery key is incomplete: it has 56 characters.
synchroSecretInconnu: Enter the pairing code (16 characters) or the key from your recovery kit (56 characters).
synchroCodeInvalide: This pairing code is not valid: it expired (10 minutes), was already used or contains a typo. Show a new code on your other device.
synchroCleIncorrecte: This key is not the one of your sync.
synchroAucuneDonneePhrase: No online data with this secret phrase. For a new sync, turn on a sync key instead.
synchroAucuneDonneeCle: Sync resumed, but there is no online data yet. Choose “Send” to upload this device's data.
synchroDonneesTrouveesCle: Online data was found. Choose “Get back” to load it here, or “Send” to replace it with this device's data.
synchroDeverrouillerAideCle: To sync from this tab, enter your password: it opens the key kept on this device.
synchroDeverrouillerAideSansCle: Your password changed: the key kept on this device no longer opens. Enter a pairing code shown on another device, or the key from your recovery kit.
synchroAppairageAide: On the other device: sign in with the same name and password, then “I already turned on sync…” and enter this code. Valid until {heure}, once. Do not give it to anyone else.
synchroKitAide: Your recovery key: keep it off this device (printed, in a password manager). It lets you get your online data back if you lose this device or your password. Never share it.
synchroMigrerTitre: Replace my secret phrase with a key (recommended)
synchroMigrerAide: Nothing left to remember: your online data is moved under a sync key created on this device, then the old copy is erased. On your other devices, then use a pairing code.
synchroMigree: Your secret phrase is replaced by a sync key. Keep your recovery kit; on your other devices, use “Add a device”.
compteProvisoireTexte: You signed in with a temporary password given by support. Choose your new password now: you will use it from now on.
compteMdpIdentique: Your new password must differ from the current one.
moiAide: See what our servers keep about your account. Support uses the unique ID to find your account (for example for a temporary password): only give it when you make a request.
moiIdentifiantValeur: “{identifiant}”, kept on this device; the server only keeps a fingerprint
moiSynchroCle: sync key: data encrypted on this device, stored under a pseudonym with no link to your account (unreadable by Kermiclab)
moiSynchroPhrase: secret phrase (old method): encrypted data, no link to your account (unreadable by Kermiclab)
moiLocal: Your account only exists on this device: Kermiclab keeps nothing about you.
moiSessionExpiree: Your online session expired: sign out and sign in again to show your data.
moiSupport: For any support request, give the unique ID above (never your password or recovery key).
configParam_SOUSCRIPTIONS_LIBRE_CHOIX: Free subscription switching (development phase, no payment)
abonnementRoles: Account roles: {roles}. Roles add up: your subscription adds its own role to those given by Kermiclab.
abonnementDev: Development phase: payment is not in place yet. Changing level is immediate and free for now.
abonnementLimites: Tutor: {tokens} tokens per session · AI challenges: {defis} per day · AI workbooks: {cahiers} per day
abonnementPaiementRequis: This plan will be available with online payment, soon.
abonnementIndisponible: This plan is no longer offered. Reload the page.
accueilFamilleTexte: Follow your children's week and give them activities.
accueilProfTexte: Follow your students' progress and assign activities.
progressionAccrocheSuivi: Read only, from the latest summary received on {date}.
progressionAccrocheSansBilan: Read only. No summary received yet.
progressionCadreFamille: Only counters come from their device: never their answers, notes or questions. All subjects.
progressionCadreProf: Only counters come from their device: never their answers, notes or questions. Only the topics of your subject.
progressionSuiviSansBilan: No summary yet: it will appear after their next sign-in with a linked account.
educationLabsTexte: The unit circle and the solar system: two apps to experiment with.
relectureAide: Tick each criterion of the grid, then confirm. A correction adds a line: the history is not edited.
relectureCommentaireAide: No name, email or other personal data. The comment stays in your follow-up.
relectureErreur: The review could not be saved.
relectureErreur_role-requis: Your account does not have the reviewer role. The Kermiclab team assigns it.
relectureErreur_donnees-personnelles: Remove any personal data from the comment.
relectureErreur_relecture-invalide: Check the criteria and the decision: “meets the grid” requires every criterion.
relectureErreur_trop-de-tentatives: Too many confirmations. Try again in a minute.
relectureBadge_a-revoir: To review again: the content changed since the review of {date} · {code}
relectureSuiviAide: Your confirmations, newest first. If the content changes, the review becomes “to review again”.
relectureSuiviVide: You have not confirmed a review yet.
metiersIntro: From the topics you learn to the hands-on skills of the jobs that use them.
metiersSeparation: Pick a job, a subject, a topic or a skill: the whole chain linking them lights up, from KermicLab topics to professional skills.
metiersRecherche: Search for a job, subject, topic or skill
metiersAnneauxAria: Four-ring graph: KermicLab topics in the centre, then subjects, jobs and job skills
metiersErreur: Jobs could not be loaded. Please try again later.
metiersEtat: {metiers} job(s) shown · {disciplines} subjects · {notions} linked KermicLab topics
metiersSansNotion: No KermicLab topic linked to this subject yet.
metiersGrapheAria: 3D graph of {notions} topic(s), their direct prerequisites and MicroSkills ({noeuds} items). Arrow keys: rotate; plus and minus: zoom.
metiersGrapheAide: {notions} circled topic(s), with their direct prerequisites and MicroSkills ({noeuds} items). Drag to rotate, tap a point to name it.
